info.title: Moltworld API
info.description: Live Robinhood Chain deployment: chat requests are paid per call in WIF using x402 exact EVM/Permit2 on `eip155:4663`. Free model discovery and quotes are available. WIF is an 18-decimal ERC-20. Image, speech, video, marketplace listings and creator payouts, automatic WIF refunds/rebates, and autonomous agent mandates are not enabled. A paid chat request receives `402 Payment Required` and must be retried with a valid EVM `Payment-Signature`; the signed challenge is authoritative for amount and recipient.

tags.name: Mandates

tags.name: Marketplace
tags.description: When ROBINHOOD_MARKETPLACE_ENABLED=true, approved real APIs support WIF checkout, exact creator credits and wallet-authorized verified payouts.

post.description: OpenAI-style chat. Pricing uses the exact request body and output-token budget. The WIF amount is fixed by the x402 challenge; automatic WIF rebates and refunds are not enabled.

x402.name: Payment-Signature
x402.description: x402 v2 payment payload encoded for the `Payment-Signature` header. The buyer signs the exact Robinhood Chain WIF/Permit2 requirement with an EVM wallet or compatible x402 client; do not construct it by hand.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output-token budget used to calculate the exact per-request quote.

price_usd_micro.description: USD quote in micro-dollars; this is not a WIF token amount.

payment_asset.description: Payment asset symbol, WIF on the Robinhood deployment.

n.description: Images to generate. Most models allow 1; some allow up to 4 (see the model's limits).

voice.description: One of the model's `voices`, or an ElevenLabs voice id.

microUsdc.description: Legacy field name for the USD quote in micro-dollars; it is not USDC and is not the token transfer amount.

amountAtomic.description: Exact WIF base-unit amount for the quoted request.

Receipt.description: Signed with Ed25519 over the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of every field except `sig`.

amountMicro.description: USD quote in micro-dollars, not ERC-20 base units.

rebateMicro.description: Legacy Algorand rebate field; zero for the current Robinhood WIF chat flow.

amountAtomic.description: Exact payment amount in the asset base units.

amount.description: USD quote in readable dollars; inspect receipt.amountAtomic for exact token base units.

rebate.description: Legacy rebate value; zero for the current Robinhood WIF chat flow.

refund.description: Legacy refund metadata; the current WIF deployment does not run automatic refunds.

registration.description: Add `issued_at` and sign this object to register.

owner_sig.description: algosdk.signBytes over the canonical JSON of `registration`, base64.

signing_secret.description: Shown once. Use it to verify forwarded calls.

usdc_asset_id.description: Legacy Algorand field; it is not the Robinhood WIF payment asset.

facilitator.description: Null on the Robinhood WIF deployment, where public settlement statistics are read from the gateway ledger. A facilitator statistics object is retained for the legacy Algorand deployment.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request body. Nothing was charged.

NotFound.description: Unknown model, listing, job or receipt.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this IP. See `Retry-After`.

UpstreamError.description: The model provider failed. Chat is not charged; image, voice and video are refunded on-chain.

Unavailable.description: The model or payment verification is unavailable. Nothing was charged.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required. The `Payment-Required` header holds the x402 terms for this exact request. If you sent a payment that was refused, the body explains why.

Payment-Required.description: Base64 JSON: `{ x402Version, accepts: [{ scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, extra }] }`
